tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dbang chen 'dus pa rta mgrin yang phyung dmar po'i skong ba dben rtsa ma bzhugs so//

hrīḥ bde stong zung 'jug gdod nas dag pa'i dbyings// ma rtogs bdag 'dzin ru dra rnam gsum sde// 'dul byed rtogs pa'i ye shes rta mchog rgyal// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis mnga' gsol cing*// dpal chen khro rgyal rnams kyi stobs 'dus pa// 'khor bcas bskang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// dbang chen 'bar ba'i gar gyis gshegs su gsol// dam tshig dbang gis dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs// hrīḥ 'dod chags bde chen thabs su bsgral ba'i phyir// dpal chen rta mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*// chags 'dzin shes rab stong par sbyor ba'i phyir// yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan thugs dam bskang*// dbyings dang ye shes rol par shar ba'i phyir// sprul pa khra thabs lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// nyon mongs ye shes bzhi ru dag pa'i phyir// rigs bzhi'i dbang chen yab yum thugs dam bskang*// tshogs brgyad dbyings kyi ngang du bzhengs pa'i phyir// zil gnon yab yum brgyad po'i thugs dam bskang*// bdud bzhi rtsad gcod las bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir// sgo srung gdong can bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// rtog tshogs rnam dag ye shes ngang du rol// dbang chen bka' sdod tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// pad+mas gnyer gtad rnal 'byor skyong ba'i phyir// gter srung dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// hrīḥ phyi mchod dri med sdom pa'i nyer spyod kyis// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// nang mchod tshad med phar phyin 'dod yon gyis// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// gsang mchod 'pho med dam tshig phyag rgya yis// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// yang gsang 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dgongs pa yis// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// thun mong mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/

khyad par dam tshig sngags kyi sbyor bas bsgrubs// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// thun min rta skad thengs gsum dgongs nyams spar// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// rang bab gnyug ma'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa ches// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// rang byung ye grol lta sgom spyod pa yis// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// ma btsal lhun grub chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan// dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// kun rdzob nyes ltung gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags// don dam skye med klong du sor chud nas// rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis non// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med mdzod// phyi snod bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud dbang chen rol pa'i phyag rgya che// nyon mongs ye shes ngang du kha bskangs nas// pad+mo bkod pa'i rgyan du yongs grub shog /sku dang thig le ye nas brdal ba che// lhun rdzogs bde chen drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor du// spang blang med par chams gcig byang chub nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang sgyur shog / ces pa'ang mchims phu gre gu dge'u pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi mchod pa bgyis pa'i tshe gang dran thol byung skad cig ma'i ri mor snang bar byed pa po pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas so// dge legs 'phel// //
